## Requirements: Keep Terminal free of automatic notices

Owner request (2026-11-03): the Terminal status/prompt area is visually intrusive and must no longer cover any terminal content. This is a new *presentation* decision distinct from #2621's earlier fix (which moved bottom strips to a top absolute overlay). Preserve terminal runtime semantics rather than removing critical information.

- No automatic floating notice strips or reserved status rows inside the Terminal grid, on Web or App.
- History uncertainty, dropped input, clipboard manual Copy, and observer Take control remain available through the existing Capsule as an **explicit, context-only disclosure**, without a permanent toolbar.
- Clipboard text is not exposed in the DOM until a deliberate disclosure. The user-gesture copy path on insecure HTTP must continue to work.
- Keep stream state observable as a data attribute for diagnostics.
- Related: #2621 (old overlay behavior, intentionally superseded), #2614, #2598, #2656.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 Web/App Terminal shows no automatic status overlay and its host/grid size is identical in healthy, degraded, observer, input-drop and clipboard states.
- [ ] SC-02 A user can explicitly open all relevant notices and execute Dismiss, Copy and Take control without losing their meaning or changing PTY state.
- [ ] SC-03 Existing clipboard HTTP user-gesture copy, event expiry, focus/keyboard semantics remain correct.
